product.summary: Second-generation Passport hardware wallet, originally referred to as Passport Batch 2 and renamed Passport Core in March 2025.
product.notes: The 2025 naming change is modeled as a rebrand of the same second-generation product, not a new hardware product.

events.title: Second-generation Passport renamed Passport Core
events.description: Foundation renamed its existing second-generation Passport, previously referred to as Passport Batch 2, to Passport Core while keeping it in the product line alongside Passport Prime.
events.notes: This is modeled as a product rebrand, not a new hardware generation.

events.title: Second-generation Passport launched as Passport Batch 2
events.description: Foundation later stated that it launched its second-generation Passport device in March 2022. This second-generation product was originally known as Passport Batch 2 and was renamed Passport Core in 2025.
events.notes: WLR records month precision only. The contemporaneous March 10, 2022 Batch 2 announcement was still at the presale stage, so that announcement date is not treated as an exact shipment or general-availability day.

evidence.title: Passport is now Passport Core
evidence.notes: Primary history source for the 2020 first generation, Founder’s Edition, Batch 2/Core continuity, 2025 rename, Prime, and Envoy product family.
